recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for this issue unless a future work group decision changes the search parameter code or expression.
issue_request: FHIR-19860 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested adding a docStatus search parameter to DocumentReference so clinical-note queries can search by the underlying document lifecycle status.
initial_application: The issue was applied in PR 716 by commit 24ebc2aadefd4ba91d3d5380d091e15c61a202e2, which added a doc-status token search-parameter row over DocumentReference.docStatus to the old DocumentReference spreadsheet. The 2021 source rework commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 carried it into the current XML search-parameter bundle.
additional_context: DocumentReference is active in source/fhir.ini. Zulip discussion before the Jira filing supported adding docStatus, and OO minutes for 2019-10-10 record approval of the DocumentReference block vote including GF#19860 by 7-0-3. No later conflicting decision was found in the bounded checks.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already defines DocumentReference-doc-status with code doc-status, type token, and expression DocumentReference.docStatus.

related_jiras.note: The same application commit and block vote also added the neighboring DocumentReference content.attachment.creation search parameter, but that separate issue was not needed to decide FHIR-19860.
